children: DeepSeek CEO Liang Wenfeng told investors that the company is training a 2 trillion-parameter model and later plans to develop an 8 trillion-parameter model. According to ChainCatcher, the company’s current flagship V4-Pro has 1.6 trillion total parameters.

Among publicly disclosed large models, Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 has reached 2.8 trillion parameters. Kimi K3 uses a MoE architecture and activates 104 billion parameters per token out of its 2.8 trillion total parameters. DeepSeek's planned 8 trillion-parameter model would be nearly three times that scale.

DeepSeek completed more than 50 billion yuan in financing in July and was valued at more than $50 billion. V4-Pro was open-sourced with 1.6 trillion total parameters and 4.9 billion activated parameters.

title: DeepSeek CEO Says Company Is Training 2 Trillion-Parameter Model, Plans 8 Trillion-Parameter Model
